# agent-loop-mini\n\nMinimal tool-using agent loop over a text-only LLM port: JSON actions, step, time and context budgets, loop detection, escaped tool results and content-free events. Python package `agent-loop-mini`, import name `agent_loop_mini`, MIT licensed.\n\n## Docs\n\n- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example\n- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): design and components\n- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend tests\n- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and mitigations\n
